introModal.description: You will hear a chord. You need to select the corresponding chord color based on what you hear. You can adjust the volume and practice content in the settings at the top right corner.

messages.deleteConfirmation: Are you sure you want to delete all local statistics data? This action cannot be undone.

statistics.confirmDeleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete all local statistics data? This action cannot be undone.

training.title: Hear the shape. Find the chord.
training.subtitle: Listen for color, then the lowest note. Build a clearer picture of harmony, one chord at a time.
training.bassHint: Follows the inversion, not always the root
training.contextHint: The reference plays before the question, then clears. It never loops underneath the target chord.
training.startHint: Start with a comfortable volume. Nothing plays until you press Start.
training.compareHint: Tap another answer to compare, or move to the next chord.
training.tryAgain: Try another choice. You’re hearing the target again.
training.emptySet: No playable chords in this set. Choose another set or update Practice Settings.
training.inversionHint: The root names the chord. Its lowest sounding note determines the inversion.
training.hearingHint: Start low, keep your device volume comfortable, and take breaks. The peak limiter prevents digital overload; it does not guarantee a safe headphone level.
training.learningHint: Start with major and minor colors. Add diminished chords and sevenths next, then mix inversions. Use a tonal reference for chord-function practice; leave it off to focus on isolated color. Scores count only the first answer per question; a reveal counts as a miss.
training.shortcuts: Keyboard: Space = listen · N = next · B = bass · T = key center · Escape = stop
training.enableMidi: Enable MIDI keyboard (browser permission may be requested)
training.audioError: Audio could not start. Try again or choose the soft triangle instrument.
training.scoreHistoryHint: New scores count each question once, against its target chord. Previous statistics are preserved separately.

settings.soundSafety: Dry, centered sound with peak protection. Keep your device volume low.
settings.instrumentLoadError: Instrument failed to load. Your previous sound is still available.
settings.selectSetting: Choose a setting on the left

midi.noAccess: MIDI is unavailable in this browser
midi.error: MIDI access failed. Check your browser permissions.
